Class RankingPayload.RankingRow

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsoft.mesos.shared.payload.servertoclient.game.RankingPayload.RankingRow
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
Enclosing class:
RankingPayload
public static final class RankingPayload.RankingRow extends Object implements Serializable
A single entry of the all-time ranking: one stored game result.

The same nickname can appear in several rows because every completed game contributes one result per player.
